hooks.command: bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');let root=process.cwd();while(!fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'.git'))){const parent=path.dirname(root);if(parent===root)throw Error('Repository root not found');root=parent}import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(path.join(root,'scripts/github-body-hook.mjs')).href).then(async m=>{let s='';for await(const c of process.stdin)s+=c;try{await m.runHook(JSON.parse(s))}catch(e){process.stderr.write(e.message+'\nRead .agents/skills/writing-for-humans/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/writing-for-humans/references/change-reports.md.\n');process.exitCode=2}})"
